title: Kestrel Auto Finance Loyalty Schedule: Tenure Bonus for Long-Paying Borrowers
content:
A goodwill credit on a late fee on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts includes a tenure bonus, a flat dollar amount added to the credit, that follows the installments paid on the contract, counted as its scheduled-installment payments less its returned payments on the loan history.

| Installments paid | Tenure bonus |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | long-tenure goodwill bonus: 1.50 |
| 24 to 35 | mid-tenure goodwill bonus: 0.75 |
| fewer than 24 | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical counts)

| Scheduled-installment payments | Returned payments | Installments paid | Bonus |
|---|---|---|---|
| 37 | 1 | 36 | 1.50 |
| 36 | 1 | 35 | 0.75 |
| 24 | 0 | 24 | 0.75 |
| 25 | 2 | 23 | none |
